fusions.name: Shaken Spores
fusions.desc: Shakes spores from your fur over a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 3 damage to everything in it with a 25% chance to leave each [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Smeared Palm
fusions.desc: Smears spores into the target with an open palm, dealing 12 damage and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Lichen Grooming
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Feeding Mycelium
fusions.desc: Each time you inflict a condition, your attacks heal you for 10% of the damage they deal for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
